看板上没有定义标题是哪个阶段呢？是元数据定义的问题吗？spec 有问题吗 @copilot

> 看板上没有定义标题是哪个阶段呢？是元数据定义的问题吗？spec 有问题吗 @copilot 

The bug is not in the spec — `KanbanSchema.cardTitle` is optional by design. The issue was in the **runtime fallback logic** inside `ObjectKanban.tsx` (line 126), which is the last stage of title resolution.

The title resolution pipeline has 4 stages:

1. **Schema stage** — `schema.cardTitle` (explicit config) ✅ Spec is fine
2. **Metadata stage** — `objectDef.titleFormat` or `objectDef.NAME_FIELD_KEY` (from `dataSource.getObjectSchema()`) ✅ Works when metadata provides it
3. **Fallback stage** — hardcoded field name ❌ **This was the bug** — only tried `'name'` then `'title'`
4. **Default** — `'Untitled'`

When both the schema and the metadata don't specify a title field (e.g. `todo_task` objects without `titleFormat` or `NAME_FIELD_KEY` in their definition), stage 3 would only look for `item['name']` then `item.title`. Objects using `subject`, `label`, or `display_name` as their title field all fell through to 'Untitled'.

The fix expands stage 3 to try: `name → title → subject → label → display_name`, using the first non-empty value found.
